00123 - (int)setupRemoteIO
00124 {
00125     if(rioUnit) AudioComponentInstanceDispose(rioUnit);
00126     
00127     // Open the output unit
00128     AudioComponentDescription desc;
00129     desc.componentType = kAudioUnitType_Output;
00130     desc.componentSubType = kAudioUnitSubType_RemoteIO;
00131     desc.componentManufacturer = kAudioUnitManufacturer_Apple;
00132     desc.componentFlags = 0;
00133     desc.componentFlagsMask = 0;
00134     
00135     AudioComponent comp = AudioComponentFindNext(NULL, &desc);
00136     AudioComponentInstanceNew(comp, &rioUnit);
00137     
00138     const UInt32 one = 1;
00139     AudioUnitSetProperty(rioUnit, kAudioOutputUnitProperty_EnableIO, kAudioUnitScope_Input, 1, &one, sizeof(one));  
00140     AudioUnitSetProperty(rioUnit, kAudioUnitProperty_SetRenderCallback, kAudioUnitScope_Input, 0, &inputProc, sizeof(inputProc));
00141     
00142     AudioUnitSetProperty(rioUnit, kAudioUnitProperty_StreamFormat, kAudioUnitScope_Input, 0, &format, sizeof(format));
00143     AudioUnitSetProperty(rioUnit, kAudioUnitProperty_StreamFormat, kAudioUnitScope_Output, 1, &format, sizeof(format));
00144     
00145     AudioUnitInitialize(rioUnit);
00146     
00147     return 0;   
00148 }

00150 - (OSStatus)renderCallback:(UInt32)inNumberFrames 
00151            withActionFlags:(AudioUnitRenderActionFlags*)ioActionFlags
00152                atTimeStamp:(const AudioTimeStamp*)inTimeStamp 
00153                withBuffers:(AudioBufferList*)ioData
00154 {
00155     OSStatus err = 0;
00156     
00157     [self lock];
00158     
00159     if(audioInputIsAvailable)
00160     {
00161         err = AudioUnitRender(rioUnit, ioActionFlags, inTimeStamp, 1, inNumberFrames, ioData);
00162         if (err) { printf("renderCallback: error %d\n", (int)err); return err; }
00163     }
00164     
00165     if(inNumberFrames > bufferSize)
00166     {
00167         delete  floatBuffer;
00168         bufferSize = inNumberFrames;
00169         
00170         floatBuffer = new float[inNumberFrames * NUM_CHANNELS];
00171     }
00172     
00173     long blockID = UGen::getNextBlockID(inNumberFrames);
00174     
00175     float *floatBufferData;
00176     floatBufferData = floatBuffer;
00177     floatBufferData = floatBufferData + inNumberFrames;
00178     
00179     if(audioInputIsAvailable)
00180     {
00181         for (UInt32 channel = 0; channel < numInputChannels; channel++)
00182         {
00183             AudioSampleType *audioUnitBuffer = (AudioSampleType*)ioData->mBuffers[0].mData;
00184             float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00185             
00186             for(int sample = 0; sample < inNumberFrames; sample++)
00187             {
00188                 floatBufferChannel = (float)audioUnitBuffer[sample] * PCM16BitToFloat_Factor;
00189             }       
00190         }
00191         
00192         rawInput.getSource().setInputs((const float**)floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, numInputChannels);
00193     }
00194     else
00195     {
00196         memset(floatBuffer, 0, numInputChannels * inNumberFrames * sizeof(float));
00197     }
00198     
00199     postFadeOutput.setOutputs(floatBufferData, inNumberFrames, 2);
00200     postFadeOutput.prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00201     
00202     const UInt32 numBuffers = ioData->mNumberBuffers;
00203     for (UInt32 channel = 0; channel < numBuffers; channel++)
00204     {
00205         AudioSampleType *audioUnitBuffer = (AudioSampleType*)ioData->mBuffers[channel].mData;
00206         float *floatBufferChannel = floatBufferData[channel];
00207         
00208         for(int sample = 0; sample < inNumberFrames; sample++)
00209         {
00210             audioUnitBuffer = (AudioSampleType)(floatBufferChannel[sample] * FloatToPCM16Bit_Factor);
00211         }
00212     }
00213     
00214     const int numOthers = others.size();
00215     for(int i = 0; i < numOthers; i++)
00216     {
00217         others.prepareAndProcessBlock(inNumberFrames, blockID);
00218     }   
00219     
00220     [self unlock];
00221     
00222     return err; 
00223 }

00225 - (void)propertyCallback:(AudioSessionPropertyID)inID
00226                 withSize:(UInt32)inDataSize 
00227             withProperty:(const void *)inPropertyValue
00228 {   
00229     if(!isRunning) return;
00230     
00231     if(inPropertyValue)
00232     {
00233         CFDictionaryRef routeChangeDictionary  = (CFDictionaryRef)inPropertyValue;
00234         CFNumberRef     routeChangeReasonRef   = 
00235         (CFNumberRef)CFDictionaryGetValue (routeChangeDictionary, 
00236                                            CFSTR (kAudioSession_AudioRouteChangeKey_Reason));
00237         
00238         SInt32 routeChangeReason;
00239         CFNumberGetValue(routeChangeReasonRef, kCFNumberSInt32Type, &routeChangeReason);
00240         
00241         CFStringRef newAudioRoute;
00242         UInt32 propertySize = sizeof (CFStringRef);
00243         AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_AudioRoute, &propertySize, &newAudioRoute);
00244         
00245         printf("route=%s\n", CFStringGetCStringPtr(newAudioRoute, CFStringGetSystemEncoding()));
00246         
00247     }
00248     
00249     UInt32 size = sizeof(UInt32);
00250     AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareInputNumberChannels, &size, &numInputChannels);
00251     AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareOutputNumberChannels, &size, &numOutputChannels);
00252     AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_AudioInputAvailable, &size, &audioInputIsAvailable);
00253     
00254     printf("inputs=%d outputs=%d audioInputIsAvailable=%d\n", numInputChannels, numOutputChannels, audioInputIsAvailable);
00255     
00256     if(rioUnit) AudioComponentInstanceDispose(rioUnit);
00257     
00258     [self setFormat];
00259     [self setupRemoteIO];
00260     
00261     rawInput.setSource(AudioIn::AR(numInputChannels), true);
00262     postFadeOutput = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(numOutputChannels));
00263     postFadeOutput.fadeSourceAndRelease(preFadeOutput, fadeInTime);
00264     
00265     AudioSessionSetActive(true);
00266     AudioOutputUnitStart(rioUnit);
00267     
00268 }

00270 - (void)interruptionCallback:(UInt32)inInterruption
00271 {
00272     if (inInterruption == kAudioSessionEndInterruption) {
00273         // make sure we are again the active session
00274         //AudioSessionSetActive(false);
00275         AudioSessionSetActive(true);
00276         isRunning = true;
00277         AudioOutputUnitStart(rioUnit);
00278     }
00279     
00280     if (inInterruption == kAudioSessionBeginInterruption) {
00281         isRunning = false;
00282         AudioOutputUnitStop(rioUnit);
00283         
00284         printf("InterruptionListener audioInputIsAvailable=%d\n", audioInputIsAvailable);
00285         
00286         UIAlertView *baseAlert = [[UIAlertView alloc] initWithTitle:@"Audio interrupted" 
00287                                                             message:@"This could have been interrupted by another application or due to unplugging a headset:" 
00288                                                            delegate:self
00289                                                   cancelButtonTitle:nil
00290                                                   otherButtonTitles:@"Resume", @"Cancel", nil];
00291         [baseAlert show];
00292     }   
00293 }

00312     AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareSampleRate, &size, &hwSampleRate);
00313

00316

00319     
00320     rawInput = Plug::AR(UGen::emptyChannels(NUM_CHANNELS));
00321     preFadeOutput = [self constructGraph: rawInput];
00322     
00323     rioUnit = NULL;
00324     isRunning = true;
00325     [self propertyCallback:0 
00326                   withSize:0 
00327               withProperty:0]; // call directly this first time
00328

00331

00334     AudioSessionGetProperty(kAudioSessionProperty_CurrentHardwareIOBufferDuration, &size, &bufferDuration);
00335

00337     floatBuffer = new float[bufferSize * NUM_CHANNELS];
